author: musho7-dev
subject: Add TUNE screen: per-car upgrades, paint and decals for every car
body:
- TUNE & UPGRADE button in the car card opens a screen with the car big
  in a live preview, its stat bars, and 3 tabs: UPGRADES (moved here from
  the car list), PAINT (Original + 11 colors) and DECALS (stripes,
  number, stars, checker, flames)
- Every car remembers its own paint and decal; shown in runs, the garage
  background and the share picture. Picture cars get a color tint,
  drawn cars are repainted; decals are clipped to each body's shape
- Paints/decals are bought once and work on all cars (shared with the
  Workshop); tapping one you don't own previews it with BUY / Cancel
- The Workshop car's button opens the Workshop instead
- Decal drawing shared by all cars (Workshop uses the same code)
